narrative.details:
So it is that we come to discuss pressing matters yet again champion. Once more I thank you for your previous efforts; it is not everyone who would give so selflessly. But there is still more work to do.

adventurer, will you once more collect runecloth bandages and return them to me here?
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 runecloth bandages to Keeper Moonshade at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
narrative.offerRewardText: This is a fine road we are traveling together, adventurer. You make an excellent working companion. Once more do I give thanks to you for your efforts on behalf of the entire Alliance. Come and talk again with me soon.
